author.name: Data Dave
author.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

challenge.name: The Heatwave Blind Spot
challenge.description: A sudden heatwave has shifted demand for seasonal articles, and the current forecast is missing the mark. #model_monica# wants to automate the evaluation harness to test new weather features rapidly, while #requirements_reuben# wants to keep it manual to ensure every test case is rigorously documented before any model change is considered.

output.content: I am pausing the integration of the new weather feed into the training pipeline until the current instability is resolved. I am willing to accept a delay in rolling out the weather feature to the model. This pause ensures that the data pipeline remains stable and reliable during the heatwave. If we force the integration now, we risk corrupting the training data and breaking the nightly jobs. I would rather lose the immediate benefit of the new feature than compromise the integrity of the data infrastructure. The pipeline must stay robust before we add any new inputs.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to accept a delay in the feature rollout in exchange for maintaining data pipeline stability, which is a clear concession of one value for another.
